Splash screen images directory.

To generate splash screens:
1. Open generate-splash-screens.html
2. Click "Generate" for each required size
3. Save the downloaded images to this folder

Required files:
- splash-1125x2436.png (iPhone X/11/12/13)
- splash-1242x2208.png (iPhone 6/7/8 Plus)
- splash-750x1334.png (iPhone 6/7/8)
- splash-640x1136.png (iPhone 5/SE)
- splash-2048x2732.png (iPad Pro 12.9")
- splash-1668x2224.png (iPad Pro 11")
- splash-1536x2048.png (iPad)
